description: Compare 2 to 5 stocks side by side. Returns price, daily change, market cap, P/E ratio, dividend yield, volume, 52-week range, sector, revenue, profit margin, EPS, and beta. Use this for "compare Apple and Microsoft", "which is a better investment, NVDA or AMD?", "tech stock comparison", or any stock-vs-stock analysis.

symbols.description: Ticker symbols, 2-5 stocks. Accept either CSV string ("AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL") or array (["AAPL","MSFT","GOOGL"]).

name: stock_compare
